notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001065280-26-000034, filed January 23, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-159286, filed April 16, 2026), read on EDGAR. SPLIT: Netflix completed a ten-for-one forward stock split on November 14, 2025; all share counts here are post-split. LEADER: Hastings beneficially owns 37,759,062 shares as of April 6, 2026, marked * (less than 1%) in the proxy, so pctEconomic is null. The figure includes options on 16,595,546 shares and 21,159,576 shares held by the Hastings-Quillin Family Trust, of which he is a trustee; the trust is part of his total and is not listed separately. He became non-executive Chairman on April 17, 2025, and the 2026 proxy says he will not stand for re-election to the Board at the June 4, 2026 annual meeting. HOLDERS: the Vanguard, BlackRock and FMR figures still rest on Schedule 13G/A filings reporting holdings at the end of December 2023 (split-adjusted), applied against the April 6, 2026 share count; the FMR footnote gives 'As of December 29, 2023' but cites a 13G/A 'filed April 7, 2025', so its true date is uncertain. The proxy's Vanguard footnote adds that a later Schedule 13G/A filed March 27, 2026 reports The Vanguard Group at 0.0% as of March 13, 2026 after an internal reorganization that disaggregated its holdings; the table's 8.65% is kept as the proxy states it. GEOGRAPHY: the four regional streaming revenues sum to total streaming revenues of $45,183,036 thousand, which equals total revenues (no DVD revenue in 2025). Stock comp is the cash-flow line; the 10-K says the company grants non-qualified stock options to employees monthly.

footprint.notes: Netflix reports employees and (through FY2024) memberships only by its four regions (UCAN, EMEA, LATAM, APAC); no country or state figures. Employees come from the FY2025 10-K Human Capital section (approximately 16,000 full-time employees at Dec 31, 2025). The FY2025 10-K no longer prints paid memberships by region (its MD&A says 'During the year ended December 31, 2025, we discontinued the reporting of membership numbers'), so the membership rows stay on the FY2024 10-K Note 1 table, as of Dec 31, 2024: printed in thousands and stored multiplied by 1,000 (301.6 million in total). Each region therefore has two rows, one per source and period. Only UCAN carries a country list because the filing names it 'United States and Canada'; the other regions' member countries are not defined in the filing. Sites: HQ and LA from the FY2025 10-K Item 2 (which gives no production-hub list); production hubs from Netflix's own news pages (Albuquerque 2024, Shepperton 2019, Tres Cantos 2022), all still live (checked 2026-11-24). Other hubs (e.g. Toronto, Fort Monmouth NJ plans) were not checked against a company page and are omitted.
